id: title:benben:show artifact age in the artifacts tab

review.posthog_relevance: Adds TypeScript typing and runtime support for timestamp fields, and changes metadata display from long-form relative time to short-form, improving the TaskArtifactsList UI's ability to display PR and canvas age alongside state.
review.reason: Adds TypeScript type and runtime support for a timestamp field on PR and canvas artifact rows, and changes the displayed metadata from a long-form relative time to a short-form one. This is a localized maintenance and UI improvement.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit of switching from long-form to short-form time display is not demonstrated; this could be a minor UX preference rather than a critical reliability or correctness fix. No production incident or systemic risk reduction is evidenced.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier assignment requires the reviewer's judgment, not the classifier's.
